The workbook generation failed due to invalid Excel formulas resulting in #NAME? errors in the statistics section.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with an AssertionError because cells H46 through L47 contained '#NAME?' instead of the expected numeric statistical values. This error typically indicates a typo in a formula name, a missing named range, or an unsupported Excel function in the generated worksheet. While the file structure and lookup blocks passed, the derived statistics mismatches included: H46 (expected -1.518, got #NAME?) and H47 (expected 3.151, got #NAME?).
